scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Warning: pnpm is recommended for this project" >&2 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/web --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/web --filter ./scripts --if-present run typecheck
